template.name: Authoring Demo (format v2)
template.description: Green format-v2 fixture: a pinned multi-part files input, realm/agent/file placements, a launch directive, an extension tool reference, and a declared publishing authority.
template.notes: Current-format twin of legacy/authoring_demo_v1: one two-agent realm re-authored against the format-v2 schema. Validated by the real realmCatalog through scripts/validate_realm_artifacts.mjs.

inputs.label: Topic
inputs.help: The subject of the realm; supplied by the operator at launch.

inputs.label: Lore corpus
inputs.help: Ordered markdown files. Each part is pinned into the Director prompt by path and the whole fileset is seeded under the realm-global lore/ root.
inputs.brief: One markdown file per lore topic; order the files by path with 01_index.md first.

inputs.label: Opening briefing
inputs.help: Optional one-paragraph briefing placed into the Director's private workspace.
inputs.brief: One paragraph framing the topic for the Director.

agents.name: Director

prompt.text: Ground every scene in the pinned lore files.

agents.initialPrompt: Open from the briefing and start the first scene.

content.text: Director online. The lore corpus is pinned.

directives.text: Open the session from the briefing and hand the floor to the Narrator.

files.files/roster.md:
# Cast roster

The Director holds the floor; the Narrator voices every scene once it starts.
files.prompts/director.md:
# Director protocol

You direct a two-agent session. The briefing frames the topic, the pinned lore parts are your canon, and the whole fileset is also seeded under `/global/lore/` for the Narrator.
files.prompts/narrator.md:
# Narrator protocol

You narrate the scenes the Director opens. Stay inside the Director's frame and never invent lore the Director has not established.
